external_companion_output_probe.conclusion: In creusot 0.12.0-dev, --output-dir places a generated .coma outside the crate, but the proof step only accepts patterns under the crate prefix. A fresh tree therefore cannot prove and emit proof.json entirely under an external output root in one supported flow. Setup route: keep raw .coma/proof.json in rust/<crate>/verif/ (worker-writable), then archive hashed copies under analysis/<stage>/results-creusot/. Do not claim full external companion-output support.
